title: World of Warcraft – The Missing Diplomat – Patch 2.3
notes: Fan-site transcript and quest sequence for the patch 2.3 Dustwallow continuation. It documents Aden, Wymor, Garn, Renn, the recovered manacles, Jaina’s Alcaz survey, the report to Bolvar, Katrana’s objection and the return to Jaina. Original-client capture is still required for promotion.
